title: Pasta's Cobblemon Experience v1
description: A custom modpack made for myself and my friends. Focuses on Cobblemon and Create, with support of smaller content mods that expands on adventuring and exploration to supplement Cobblemon, as well as performance mods.
body:
This modpack is now outdated, as it has been replaced by [Pasta's Cobblemon Experience v2](https://modrinth.com/modpack/pastas-cobblemon-experience-v2). I might patch a few issues if they are issues also present in its successor, but aside from that this version will not be supported anymore.

# DETAILED DESCRIPTION

A modpack I've been working on and tweaking privately for over two years now, made public for the sake of easy sharing and updating.

This modpack is centered around the Cobblemon and Create mods. Everything else besides those two are mods that complement these two in various ways (exploration, combat and building primarily) or just add small features that I think are fun and works well alongside everything else.

The modpack also includes most common performance optimization mods (Sodium, etc) and Iris, as well as some extra mods for the Optifine-free Optifine experience for those who wish to use resource packs.

_Note: I've heard some of the mods I've added might be considered "basic" by veteran modded players, as they are commonly used in other packs. But since I haven't been playing much modded MC since 2017, said mods don't feel overused to me, so I'm keeping them. This is a personal pack, after all._

# TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

RAM needed: While the hardware I have at hand for testing the minimum specs are limited; based on my tests with my laptop from 2019 with mid-range specs for its time, you need at minimum 6GB of RAM to run this pack (won't launch at lower amounts), and recommended RAM would be around 8-10GB.

The modpack will load the included datapacks on its own when you create a new world (so if you want to remove one, the best time is during world creation), but CobblemonRider's up-to-date config for rideable Pokémon is a separate file you need to put into your world save's folder yourself after world creation. I've included it as a loose file in the base install folder of the modpack, so just copy it and overwrite the pre-generated one in your world's folder. You can also download it yourself from CobblemonRider's modpage here on Modrinth.

If you want to run this mod on a server, you can get the necessary server files from this page: https://modrinth.com/modpack/pastas-cobblemon-server-experience-v1

You don't need to download the server version of the modpack if you don't want to; the singleplayer version can be installed onto a server too, but some mods _need_ to be deleted for the server to be able to launch. You'll also have extra mods on your server that are clientside only and only takes up more space and potentially makes the server boot up slower, but the option is there in case you prefer it.

# MISC INFO

I've included a few mods that aren't active by default, mainly MiniHUD and Leawind's Third Person mod. MiniHUD is useful, but it's overlays ends up on top of Cobblemon's UI, so I left it off by default. Leawind's Third Person is fantastic, but causes the camera distance when using a Create train to become much further back than what it's supposed to be. If you want to use Leawind's, I'd recommend setting up a keybind to let you toggle the mod on and off at will.

I won't make a Github page for this version of the modpack since it's no longer worked on.

The modpack icon is _heavily_ based on [this comic](https://x.com/lolcomicstime/status/1305728622624415744) made by LOL COMICS!.

# WHY NOT MAKE THIS FOR NEOFORGE INSTEAD?

~~Some of you may ask yourself this, and the answer is: when I started working on this, most plugins and addons for Cobblemon seemed to mainly favor Fabric + Create Fabric was up-to-date and on the same version as the at-the-time current release of Cobblemon. By now there are a good amount of mods in the pack that just isn't available if I make the jump. I have been working on a v2 of this modpack in parallel with this one that runs with the latest Cobblemon release in MC 1.21.1, but that one won't see the day until Create Fabric gets updated for it. But if that ends up taking too long, I'll probably end up hoping over to NeoForge, even if it means losing out on mods I like and having to find potential substitutes. On the bright side, it means adding some mods that I couldn't in this one.~~

I reconsidered.
